newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Bunge says has won 43 pct of Defiance.
newsitem.headline: Bunge says has won 43 pct of Defiance.

text.p: Bunge Corp said on Wednesday it has received acceptances for its revised offer for baking and milling group Defiance Mills Ltd of 17.93 million shares, or 43.2 percent of the ordinary shares on issue.
Bunge Foods Queensland Pty Ltd earlier increased its offer for Defiance to A$1.95 a share from A$1.70 a share.
Chairman Barry Weir said the acceptance level "clearly demonstrates to all shareholders that the revised Bunge offer represents full value for their investment".
Defiance directors had previously rejected the A$1.70 a share offer as too low, while an independent report had valued the group's shares at between A$2.65 and A$2.85 a share.
